mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 5.0% signals a tightening monetary policy regime that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances where FEDFUNDS exceeds 5.0%, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 3.7% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppressing equity returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 5-day returns in more than 60% of cases when UNRATE falls below 3.7%, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in residential construction starts above 1.5 million units signals strong household demand and elevated inflation expectations, leading to a delayed but persistent tightening in monetary policy and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX delivers positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is less than 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production below 100.0 with a 3-month consecutive drop signals weakening real economic activity, which triggers a policy response and reduces equity risk premiums, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO falls below 100.0 with a 3-month decline, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) signal a broad-based demand surge that accelerates inflation and forces the Fed to maintain high rates, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX generates positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases where both RSAFS and HOUST exceed thresholds, or the interaction effect Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent rise in CPIAUCSL above 3.5% combined with a stable FEDFUNDS rate signals that inflation is outpacing policy response, increasing the risk of future rate hikes and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX delivers positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where CPIAUCSL exceeds 3.5% and FEDFUNDS is stable, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200k per month combined with a declining unemployment rate signals strong labor market momentum that fuels wage growth and inflation, prompting the Fed to delay easing and suppressing equity returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of cases where PAYEMS exceeds 200k and UNRATE is below 3.9%, or the interaction Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained expansion in real GDP (GDPC1) at a 3% annualized rate combined with rising residential construction (HOUST) signals a strong late-cycle economy where inflationary pressures are entrenched, leading to a delayed but persistent negative S&P 500 return over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX delivers positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of instances where both GDPC1 and HOUST are expanding, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.
